notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

It's ebi here! I'm writing a quick post to let you know that I've uploaded a shiny new build of my old and crusty yuri VN (feat. Romantic poets!!!), Asphyxia!

This shiny new update fixes several typos in the script of Asphyxia which were found by people in my discord sever and on the Steam community page of Asphyxia. This might be an older project, but it still feels nice to dust off the cobwebs and get it all cleaned up!
I also swapped out a few of the old, janky sound effects with newer, higher quality SFX, and I edited Lillian's pyjama sprites, since a few of them had a strange dark tint on her hair that the others didn't.

That should be about it. As always, if you encounter more typos or any bugs with the new build, please let me know. I'll try to fix them in a timely manner!

- ebi x

notes.title: Double Release
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Today, my free yuri VN with a cute 18th century girl, The Sad Story of Emmeline Burns, was released on Steam. The art was done by SillySelly, who also did the art for Asphyxia, and the writing/programming was done by me, Ebi-Hime. The writing style in Emmeline Burns isn't entirely similar to Asphyxia's (it's mostly in first person, and it's not as deliberately archaic), but sections of it should feel rather familiar. Also, despite the title, it's not as downbeat as Asphyxia is. Please feel free to check it out, if you are so inclined.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/429940

And the next VN is pretty different from Asphyxia and Emmeline - even though the art is, again, by SillySelly, and the writing/programming is by me. Strawberry Vinegar a light-hearted slice of life/comedy VN, with a lot of silly anime clichés, and a lot of CGs of delicious-looking food. If you want to read something cute and (hopefully) funny, please consider taking a look. There are also some minor yuri elements, but they're not very explicit, because the main characters are pretty young (at least, in the main body of the game). SV is available here, and is $9.99 (but with a 15% discount during launch week).

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407340

Thank you to everybody who has supported me so far! If you read these VNs, I hope you enjoy them!
